access.denied: Receiving is only for purchasers, receivers and system admins.
access.readOnly: System admins can view receiving but not register or change deliveries.

list.title: Deliveries
list.search: Search DL number, source or note

box.title: Register a box
box.intro: One line per kind of thing in the box. Type or scan the SKU or the name; matching orders show up as you type.
box.name: Name
box.whatRequired: Enter a SKU or a name.

candidates.title: Match to an order line (optional)
candidates.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 characters of the SKU or name to see open order lines.
candidates.none: No open order line matches. Save anyway and match later.
candidates.leftPending: {{count}} more than the chosen lines lack; they stay pending.

line.title: Lines
line.pendingRest: {{count}} still pending. If the vendor sent more than ordered, mark the rest as not needing a match.

match.title: Match line #{{n}}: {{name}}
match.help: The box line has {{good}} good and {{problem}} with a problem. The system's suggestion is filled in; change it if needed. A problem quantity opens a problem on that order line.
match.overHint: This line lacks only {{short}}; the extra {{extra}} will stay pending.
match.totals: Assigned: {{good}} of {{goodOf}} good, {{problem}} of {{problemOf}} with a problem
match.tooMany: More than the box line holds.

noMatch.help: For gifts, over-deliveries or things bought outside the system. On a partly matched line the rest counts as not needed.
noMatch.undoHelp: The line goes back to the matching worklist.

void.help: Its matches and their unresolved problems are voided too.

receiving.title: Receiving
receiving.intro: Delivery lines waiting for a match, and for purchasers the problems to settle and the short lines to decide on.

problem.title: Problems
problem.unresolveHelp: The problem is open again; a refund entry it created is voided.

actionHelp.exchange: Wait for the vendor to send a replacement; it is matched like any delivery.
actionHelp.return_no_replace: The units are returned and no longer expected; you can record a refund.

problem.refundHelp: Optional, entered as a positive amount; it becomes a ledger entry on the line.
